name: zero-to-one
description: Repository-wide tooling only (formatting, linting, Markdown gates). Track dependencies stay in each track's own package.json.

scripts.lint:md: npm run lint:wrap && npm run lint:tables && npm run lint:links && npm run lint:mermaid && npm run lint:katex && npm run lint:headings
scripts.check: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:md
